cases.disease: Progressive infantile onset leukoencephalopathy with or without deafness
cases.mechanism_detail: An SVA insertion within the KARS1 coding sequence (c.856_857insSVA) was found by manual read inspection in trans with a pathogenic KARS1 SNV in a child with microcephaly, hearing impairment and developmental delay; reported as a VUS though suspected disease-causing. Functional effect not investigated.
cases.quote: KARS1 c.856_857insSVA (MEI) reported in trans with Pathogenic KARS1 SNV
